Results.ReviewText: I normally don't rate a product until I've had it long enough to see how it performs over time but I'm giving this grill a somewhat low rating based on some early problems. The scale that indicates the amount of propane in the tank has a hook to hang the propane tank & that design was awful. The tank was very difficult to fit on the hook, due to misdesign. After calling three times to "tech support", I finally talked to someone who seemed to know something about grills. Turns out, Weber already had a retrofit to cure the problem & it was sent to me rather quickly. Seems they should have gotten this to the retailers to be included with the grill purchase & the other "tech support" people certainly should have know about it. Oh, by the way, the second support person didn't even recognize the model when I gave him the exact information. Even with the replacement part, it's pretty hard to get the tank hung on the hook because of the weight of a full tank & the awkward positioning. Another poor design feature is the openings in the housing that allow rain water to fill the grease tray.
Results.Title: Design flaws & mixed quality of support

Taste the difference a Spirit will make in your life. With features such as porcelain enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. Designed to fit on a small patio or balcony, the Spirit E-210 gas grill brings grilling to any home.
